notes: Versioned companion to the IMMUTABLE config/vera_eval_freeze.json. Every change here is a new run_config_version and a new run fingerprint. success_criteria are read from the freeze file and are never copied here. v2 (2026-10-02): adds the search block (M2 redo, keyless arXiv first route, disclosed seed fallback). v3 (2026-10-04, item #71): search.mode fan_out, search.query_terms (query translation), search.rrf_k, search.openalex (keyless scholarly index); arXiv query shape changes. v3 also adds search.duckduckgo_lite (keyless DISCOVERY-only link finder, item #71 section 7a) and search.max_share. v3 also adds search.doaj (keyless DOAJ article search, item #71 section 10) and a DuckDuckGo per-question cache with daily cap 8 (section 11, R11-b). v4 (2026-10-23, ROUTE-R3): DDG-first provider order (arXiv last), search.soft_max_share, duckduckgo_lite.memory_cache_ttl_s.

freeze_pin.line_endings: sha256 is computed over the file bytes with CRLF normalised to LF and a UTF-8 BOM removed

search.providers_note: ROUTE-R3 (2026-10-23, owner rule project_ddg_first_source: DuckDuckGo first for queries not in the corpus): chain order is the CALL order of the reading-list fan-out (grounding.providers and scope_router offtopic_providers only filter it). DDG first, then the scholarly portals, arXiv last (kept, not removed). RRF ties are no longer broken by this position (search_and_fetch.rrf_merge), and soft_max_share keeps any one portal from filling the top-n while other eligible results exist.
search.soft_max_share_note: ROUTE-R3: UNCALIBRATED planner prior (no per-portal live composition is on record; work/route-r1/TRACE.md section 3). Per-portal limit on the final top-n (num_results 5 on /ask), applied after the hard max_share; items over it move to the END of the list (backfill), so they are shown only when no other eligible result exists. 3 of 5 leaves at least 2 slots for other portals. Change it after a measured per-portal composition on real questions.

arxiv.terms_source: https://info.arxiv.org/help/api/tou.html (read via research summary 2026-10-02, NOT verbatim; the one-request-per-3s limit is labelled for legacy APIs, re-check at L1)

openalex.terms_source: https://docs.openalex.org/how-to-use-the-api/rate-limits-and-authentication (item #71 plan section 6, R1-a; keyless daily allowance guarded at 90 searches per process-day)

doaj.terms_source: https://doaj.org/api/v4/docs (two requests per second; read by the orchestrator 2026-10-04) and DOAJ terms (article metadata under a CC0 waiver); item #71 plan section 10, R10-a. Keyless; plain terms only (a quoted phrase with AND returned 0 hits in the probe).

duckduckgo_lite.memory_cache_note: ROUTE-R3 (D2): with cache_dir null there was no cache, so one corpus-miss question spent the daily cap twice (inline acquisition, then the reading list, same shared instance and same question). This in-process cache (url + title only, as the disk cache) serves the second call of the same question. 900 s is an UNCALIBRATED planner prior (one request plus retries); daily_query_cap is unchanged. 0 switches it off.
duckduckgo_lite.terms_source: https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/settings/params and https://duckduckgo.com/acceptable-use (read verbatim by the orchestrator 2026-10-04; item #71 plan section 7a). DISCOVERY ONLY: DuckDuckGo results are used to find source URLs; VERA never displays DuckDuckGo snippets, pages or ranking. Params page says the parameters are intended for individual use; low volume (5 s gate, daily cap); a 202 or challenge page is a failure and is never evaded. Switch off with enabled=false.
